valuation.method: Forward EPS x P/E (FY2027 adjusted diluted EPS viewed at the 12-month target date)

bear.driver: Elevated jet fuel costs and non-fuel unit cost inflation compress margins while premium travel demand softens.

base.driver: Jet fuel volatility moderates, premium/loyalty revenue growth continues, and ongoing debt reduction supports multiple stability.

bull.driver: Strong corporate and international premium demand drives margin expansion above 2026 levels, with lower leverage supporting a re-rating.

valuation.implied_by_close: At base FY2027 EPS of $7.40, the $86.25 close implies 11.7x; the equal-weight 5-analyst target of $109.00 implies 14.7x at base EPS or $8.72 EPS at the base 12.5x multiple.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $7.40 (8.6 pp).
valuation.watch_metric: Q4 2026 / FY2027 jet fuel cost per gallon and TRASM (total revenue per available seat mile) growth

analyst_notes: All five named analyst calls in this panel predate the October 9, 2026 Q3 earnings release (where management trimmed FY2026 EPS guidance to $5.10-$5.60 due to jet fuel headwinds), though TD Cowen's Tom Fitzgerald trimmed his target from $105 to $101 on October 2 ahead of the print. The panel is uniformly Buy/Overweight with an equal-weight target of $109.00 (+26.4% vs. $86.25 close), sitting 19.2 pp above the independent base case (+7.2%) as brokers price in a sharper FY2027 earnings recovery or higher multiple than 12.5x.
